verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly list a 'Debug live web applications | Chrome' feature and describe Claude Code's computer-use ability to open apps, navigate the browser, and run dev tools, indicating live-app debugging support tied to Chrome integration. However, evidence is limited to a title/short description with no detailed workflow documentation or independent/hands-on confirmation that this works as advertised.
